topics.title: Subject-Verb Agreement
topics.lesson: Verb harus cocok dengan subjek utama, bukan kata yang dekat dengannya. The results of the study are clear. Ingat: each, every, either, neither + of → verb tunggal. The number of → tunggal, a number of → jamak.
topics.trap: Frasa 'of the ...' atau 'in the ...' di tengah kalimat sengaja dipasang untuk mengecoh. Coret dulu frasa itu, cari subjeknya.

topics.title: Tenses
topics.lesson: Past perfect (had + V3) untuk kejadian yang terjadi lebih dulu dari kejadian lampau lain. Present perfect (has/have + V3) dipakai dengan since, for, already, yet. Past continuous untuk aksi yang sedang berlangsung saat aksi lain memotong.
topics.trap: Kata kunci waktu (since, by the time, when) hampir selalu menentukan jawaban. Cari kata itu dulu.

topics.title: Parallelism
topics.lesson: Item dalam daftar atau pasangan (and, or, but, not only...but also) harus berbentuk sama: semua V-ing, semua to-infinitive, semua kata dasar, atau semua kata benda.
topics.trap: Lihat item pertama di daftar, lalu samakan item terakhir dengannya. Jawaban yang 'terdengar enak' sering salah.

topics.title: Conditionals
topics.lesson: Type 1: If + present, will + V1. Type 2: If + were/V2, would + V1. Type 3: If + had + V3, would have + V3. Type 3 bisa diinversi: Had I known, ...
topics.trap: Pada Type 2, 'were' dipakai untuk semua subjek (If I were, If she were). 'Was' biasanya jebakan.

topics.title: Word Forms
topics.lesson: Satu kata punya banyak bentuk. Noun muncul setelah a/the atau adjektiva (success). Adjective berada sebelum noun atau setelah be (successful). Adverb menerangkan verb atau adjektiva (successfully). Akhiran umum: -tion/-ment/-ness (noun), -ful/-ive/-ous (adjektiva), -ly (adverb). Adjektiva -ing = penyebab perasaan, -ed = yang merasakan.
topics.trap: Tanyakan dulu: posisi kosong ini butuh jenis kata apa? Lihat kata di kiri dan kanannya.

topics.title: Find the Error
topics.lesson: Pada soal Written Expression, satu bagian kalimat salah dan kamu harus menemukannya. Periksa berurutan: (1) subject-verb agreement, (2) tense, (3) bentuk kata, (4) preposisi, (5) tunggal/jamak, (6) paralelisme.
topics.trap: Jangan tertipu bagian yang terdengar aneh. Periksa tiap bagian secara tata bahasa. Biasanya hanya ada satu kesalahan.

questions.q: The results of the experiment ____ surprising.
Neither the teacher nor the students ____ ready.
questions.e: Pada neither...nor, verb mengikuti subjek yang terdekat: students (jamak) → are.

questions.q: Each of the books ____ a different cover.
questions.e: Each of + kata benda jamak tetap memakai verb tunggal: has.

questions.q: The number of students ____ increasing every year.
questions.e: The number of = tunggal → is. (A number of = jamak.)

questions.q: By the time we arrived, the movie ____.
questions.e: By the time + past → kejadian sebelumnya memakai past perfect: had already started.

questions.q: She ____ in Jakarta since 2019.
I ____ TV when the phone rang.
questions.e: Aksi yang sedang berlangsung lalu dipotong aksi lain → past continuous: was watching.

questions.q: Tomorrow at this time, we ____ on the beach.
questions.e: 'Tomorrow at this time' = aksi berlangsung di masa depan → will be lying.

questions.q: She enjoys swimming, hiking, and ____.
questions.e: Item sebelumnya V-ing, jadi item terakhir juga V-ing: reading.

questions.q: The job requires patience, creativity, and ____.
He is not only intelligent but also ____.
To succeed, you must study hard, sleep well, and ____ healthy food.
questions.e: Setelah must, semua verb berbentuk dasar: study, sleep, eat.

questions.q: If I ____ rich, I would travel the world.
If she had studied harder, she ____ the test.
If it rains tomorrow, we ____ at home.
____ I known the answer, I would have told you.
questions.e: Inversi Type 3: Had + subjek + V3 menggantikan 'If I had known'.

questions.q: The teacher, along with her students, ____ going to the museum.
Mathematics ____ my favorite subject.
questions.e: Nama pelajaran berakhiran -s (mathematics, physics, economics) dianggap tunggal → is.

questions.q: There ____ several reasons for the delay.
questions.e: Setelah there, verb mengikuti kata benda sesudahnya: reasons (jamak) → are.

questions.q: A number of students ____ absent today.
questions.e: A number of + jamak = jamak → are. (The number of = tunggal.)

questions.q: The news about the earthquakes ____ shocking.
questions.e: News adalah kata benda tak terhitung (tunggal) walau berakhiran -s → was.

questions.q: Everyone in the room ____ waiting for the announcement.
Physics and chemistry ____ required for this major.
questions.e: Dua subjek yang dihubungkan and menjadi jamak → are.

questions.q: Water ____ at 100 degrees Celsius.
We ____ to the beach last weekend.
questions.e: Last weekend = waktu lampau yang jelas → simple past: went.

questions.q: He has lived in Pekanbaru ____ ten years.
I ____ him yet.
Right now, the students ____ an exam.
questions.e: Right now = sedang berlangsung → present continuous: are taking.

questions.q: After she ____ the report, she sent it to her boss.
questions.e: Kejadian yang selesai lebih dulu dari aksi lampau lain → past perfect: had finished.

questions.q: By next year, I ____ my degree.
questions.e: By + waktu masa depan → future perfect: will have finished.

questions.q: The manager is responsible for hiring staff, ____ budgets, and planning events.
questions.e: Setelah preposisi for, daftar memakai V-ing: hiring, managing, planning.

questions.q: Students must submit the form, pay the fee, and ____ an interview.
questions.e: Setelah must, semua verb berbentuk dasar: submit, pay, attend.

questions.q: The book was both informative and ____.
Their goals are to reduce costs, increase profits, and ____ customer satisfaction.
questions.e: Daftar berpola to + V1 (to reduce, increase, (to) improve).

questions.q: The professor was kind, patient, and ____.
He would rather stay home than ____ to the party.
Walking is as healthy as ____.
questions.e: Dua hal yang dibandingkan harus sejajar: walking dan swimming.

questions.q: If I ____ you, I would apologize.
If water reaches 100°C, it ____.
questions.e: Fakta ilmiah (zero conditional): If + present, present → boils.

questions.q: If he ____ earlier, he would have caught the train.
questions.e: Type 3: If + had + V3, would have + V3.

questions.q: I would buy a car if I ____ enough money.
Unless you ____ hard, you will fail the exam.
If she ____ the lottery, she would quit her job.
If they had left earlier, they ____ the flight.
questions.e: Type 3: If + had V3, would(n't) have + V3.

questions.q: She gave a very ____ presentation.
The company grew ____ last year.
The ____ of the project surprised everyone.
He answered the questions ____.
We need to ____ the problem before it gets worse.
She is very ____ about environmental issues.
questions.e: Setelah be + very dibutuhkan adjektiva. 'Merasa peduli' → concerned.

questions.q: Their ____ helped the team finish early.
It is ____ to finish the work in one day.
The ____ news made everyone happy.
He was ____ by the test results.
Please read the ____ carefully before you sign.
questions.e: Setelah the, dan objek dari read → noun instructions.

questions.q: Identify the error: The number of students in the class are increasing.
Identify the error: She don't like to eat vegetables.
Identify the error: He has been working here since five years.
Identify the error: Neither of the answers are correct.
Identify the error: The information in this report are very useful.
Identify the error: I look forward to see you next week.
Identify the error: The students was given more time to finish the test.
Identify the error: Despite of the rain, we continued the game.
questions.e: Yang benar despite (tanpa of) atau in spite of.

questions.q: Identify the error: She is more taller than her brother.
Identify the error: If he will come, we will start the meeting.
Identify the error: He is one of the best player in the team.
